title: Venue booking fix + address reveal + onerror null-safety
notes: New: venue directory cards now show a Book button (price from bookingRate, or parsed from rate text e.g. 'R150 entry / Free')
New: venue creation stamps ownerId/ownerId/providerId so schedule.js and bookings-advance can operate on shared-directory venues
New: admin edit-venue form now includes bookingRate and cancelWindowHours fields, plus inline Approve button for pending venues
New: schedule.js venue support — venue entries appear in ownEntities with '(Venue)' label, getAvail reads entity.hours for day availability
Fixed: bookings-advance getRates now parses text rates (e.g. 'R150 entry / Free' books at R150 instead of R0)
Fixed: 8 inline avatar onerror handlers (index + provider) now null-guard nextElementSibling, eliminating the intermittent narrow-viewport smoke flake
